title: Basic
text: Basic. I bought this for my fifteen year old niece.  She lives on macaroni and cheese.  Poor girl really needs to expand her food horizon.  Lol.  Anyway, I bought this Rapid mac and cheese cooker at Dollar General for a buck.  I wouldn't pay more than a dollar for it.  I'm really shocked people actually spend more than a dollar for a basic plastic contraption.  But hey.... whatever floats your boat ..... or wallet.
